```{r}
# data import, rename and recode some variables
data <- read.csv(here("Project_1","Data", "hiv_6624_final.csv")) %>% clean_names() %>%
  filter(years %in% c(0,2)) %>%
  group_by(newid) %>%
  filter(all(c(0,2) %in% years)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    years,
    id = newid,
    drugs = hard_drugs,
    vload,
    log_vload = log(vload),
    log10_vload = log10(vload),
    leu3n = ifelse(leu3n < 0, NA_real_, leu3n),
    phys = agg_phys,
    ment = agg_ment,
    age,
    race = case_when(
      race %in% c(2,4,8) ~ "Hispanic",
      race == 1 ~ "White",
      race == 3 ~ "Black",
      race %in% c(5,6,7) ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    edu = case_when(
      educbas %in% c(1,2,3) ~ "HighSchool",
      educbas %in% c(4,5) ~ "College",
      educbas %in% c(6,7) ~ "Graduate",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    bmi = case_when(
      bmi == -1 | bmi > 100 ~ NA_character_,
      bmi < 18.5 ~ "Underweight",
      bmi >= 18.5 & bmi <= 24.9 ~ "Normal",
      bmi > 24.9 ~ "Overweight",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    depression = ifelse(cesd == -1, NA_real_, cesd),
    alcohol = dkgrp,
    smoke
  )

#  pivot wider
data_wide <- data %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = id,
    names_from = years,
    values_from = c(log_vload, log10_vload, leu3n, phys, ment,
                    drugs, age, race, edu,
                    bmi, depression, alcohol, smoke))
# outcome we use
data_wide <- data_wide %>%
  mutate(
    log_vload_change = log_vload_2 - log_vload_0,
    log10_vload_change = log10_vload_2 - log10_vload_0,
    leu3n_change = leu3n_2 - leu3n_0,
    phys_change = phys_2 - phys_0,
    ment_change = ment_2 - ment_0)

```



# missingness check
```{r}
outcomes <- c("log10_vload_change","leu3n_change","phys_change","ment_change")
predictors <- c("drugs_0","age_0","race_0","edu_0","bmi_0",
                "depression_0","alcohol_0","smoke_0")

vars <- c(outcomes, predictors)

missing_summary <- data_wide %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(vars),
      list(
        missing_n   = ~ sum(is.na(.)),
        missing_pct = ~ mean(is.na(.))
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = c("variable", ".value"),
    names_sep = "_missing_"
  )

print(missing_summary)
```

```{r}
sample_sizes <- sapply(outcomes, function(outcome){
  sum(complete.cases(data_wide[, c(outcome, predictors)]))
})

sample_sizes <- tibble(outcome = outcomes, n_complete = sample_sizes)
print(sample_sizes)
```


# range check
```{r}
range_check <- data_wide %>%
  summarise(across(c(log10_vload_0, log10_vload_2, leu3n_0, leu3n_2,
                     phys_0, phys_2, ment_0, ment_2,
                     log10_vload_change, leu3n_change, 
                     phys_change, ment_change, age_0),
                   list(min = ~min(., na.rm = TRUE),
                        max = ~max(., na.rm = TRUE)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "variable_stat",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stat = ifelse(grepl("_min$", variable_stat), "min", "max"),
    variable = sub("_(min|max)$", "", variable_stat)
  ) %>%
  select(variable, stat, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = stat,
    values_from = value
  )

print(range_check)
```

```{r}
outcomes <- c("log10_vload_change","leu3n_change","phys_change","ment_change")
outcome_labels <- c(
  "log10_vload_change" = "log10(Viral Load) Change",
  "leu3n_change" = "CD4+ T Cell Count Change",
  "phys_change" = "Aggregate Physical QoL Score Change",
  "ment_change" = "Aggregate Mental QoL Score Change"
)

plots <- lapply(outcomes, function(var){
  ggplot(data_wide, aes_string(x = var)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#2c7fb8", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = outcome_labels[var], x = "Change (2y - baseline)", y = "Count")
})

combined_plot <- (plots[[1]] | plots[[2]]) / (plots[[3]] | plots[[4]])

print(combined_plot)
ggsave(filename = here("Project_1","Report","outcome_hist_2x2.png"),
       plot = combined_plot, width = 10, height = 8)
```

# Table 1
```{r}
var_labels <- list(
  age_0 = "Age (years)",
  race_0 = "Race/Ethnicity",
  edu_0 = "Education",
  bmi_0 = "BMI category",
  depression_0 = "CESD score",
  alcohol_0 = "Alcohol use",
  smoke_0 = "Smoking",
  log10_vload_change = "Change in log10 Viral Load",
  leu3n_change = "Change in CD4 count",
  phys_change = "Change in Physical Health",
  ment_change = "Change in Mental Health"
)

table1 <- data_wide %>%
  select(drugs_0, age_0, race_0, edu_0, bmi_0,
         depression_0, alcohol_0, smoke_0,
         log10_vload_change, leu3n_change, phys_change, ment_change) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = drugs_0,
    label = var_labels,
    missing = "ifany",
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    type = list(
      age_0 ~ "continuous",
      depression_0 ~ "continuous",
      log10_vload_change ~ "continuous",
      leu3n_change ~ "continuous",
      phys_change ~ "continuous",
      ment_change ~ "continuous"
    )
  ) %>%
  add_overall(last = TRUE) %>%
  bold_labels()

table1
```


# before recode baseline: check frequency
```{r}
# no need to run this again
table_with_percent <- function(var){
  tab <- table(data[[var]], useNA = "ifany")
  prop <- prop.table(tab) * 100
  result <- cbind(Frequency = tab,
                  Percent = round(prop, 2))
  return(result)
}

table_with_percent("drugs")
table_with_percent("race")
table_with_percent("edu")
table_with_percent("income")
```
